name: IsosurfaceClassifier Lighting Model
aliases: Isosurface Volume Rendering with Phong Lighting
definition: A volume rendering lighting model for isosurface visualization that applies surface-like shading (ambient, diffuse, specular) to volumetric data near an isovalue, with transparency based on distance from isovalue.
summary: The IsosurfaceClassifier Lighting Model shades thresholded volumes using Blinn-Phong lighting on gradient-derived normals, distinguishing itself by integrating these calculations directly into the classifier's transfer function.
